tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search documentation for the following products (Product (Aliases) - [collection source types]):

- **Solo Enterprise For Istio** (istio) - [docs]
- **Solo Enterprise For Kagent** (kagent) - [docs]
- **Solo Enterprise For Kgateway** (kgateway) - [docs]
- **Solo Enterprise For Agentgateway** (agentgateway) - [docs]
- **Agentgateway Kubernetes** (agentgateway) - [docs]
- **Agentgateway Standalone** (agentgateway) - [docs]
- **Solo Enterprise For Agentregistry** (agentregistry) - [docs]
- **Agentregistry OSS** (agentregistry) - [docs]
- **Kgateway OSS** (kgateway) - [docs]
- **Kagent OSS** (kagent) - [docs]
- **Gloo Mesh Enterprise** (gloo-mesh) - [docs]
- **Gloo Edge** - [docs]
- **Gloo Gateway V1** (gloo-gateway v1) - [docs]
- **Gateway Api** - [docs]
- **Agentevals OSS** - [docs]


**Usage Note:** Evaluate search results: if they provide a complete and certain answer, then proceed. If the result is relevant but incomplete (e.g., ends mid - sentence), refers to a "see below" section, then use the `get_chunks` tool to get more context from the same document.

query.description: The search query to find relevant documentation (max 2000 characters)

product.description: The product to search documentation for

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 4)

tools.name: get_chunks
tools.description:
Retrieve sequential segments of a document to fill in missing context.

**When to use:** Use only when a `search` result is highly relevant but incomplete. This is the preferred way to "read the rest of the page" without performing additional keyword searches.

**When to skip:** Do not use if the `search` snippet already contains the full answer or if the search result is irrelevant to the user's query.

collection.description: The Qdrant collection name to query (e.g., 'istio-io_latest_docs')

url.description: The URL of the document to retrieve chunks from

endIndex.description: The ending chunk index (0-based, inclusive). Will be clamped to the maximum available index if too large.

tools.name: get_full_page
tools.description:
Retrieve the full markdown content of a documentation page by its URL from the database.

**When to use:** Use when you need the complete content of a specific page and chunk-based retrieval is insufficient.

**Limits:** Pages longer than 20,000 characters will return an error with the approximate token count. Set `force: true` to retrieve them anyway — note that very large pages consume significant context window space.

url.description: The exact URL of the documentation page to retrieve

force.description: Set to true to retrieve the page even if it exceeds the 20,000 character limit. Use with caution — large pages consume significant context.
